mapper.select: select fe.id, fe.family_member_id, fe.elder_id, e.name elderName from family_elder fe left join elder e on e.id = fe.elder_id where fe.family_member_id = #{familyMemberId} order by fe.id

select fe.id mid, fe.remark mremark, e.id elderId, e.name name, e.image image, e.bed_number bedNumber, r.type_name typeName, d.iot_id iotId, d.device_name deviceName, d.product_key productKey from family_elder fe left join elder e on e.id = fe.elder_id left join bed b on b.id = e.bed_id left join room r on r.id = b.room_id left join device d on d.id = (select d2.id from device d2 where (d2.binding_location = e.id and d2.location_type = 0 and d2.physical_location_type is null) or (e.bed_id is not null and d2.binding_location = e.bed_id and d2.physical_location_type = 2) order by d2.location_type, d2.id limit 1) where fe.family_member_id = #{familyMemberId} order by fe.id
